15 June 2026 · Publication

New paper: coverage effects in CO oxidation on stepped Pt

Our study of coverage-dependent kinetics of CO oxidation on stepped platinum surfaces is out. Lateral interactions between adsorbates turn out to shift the rate-determining step at industrially relevant pressures — a nice reminder that the clean-surface picture only goes so far.
